镜头 s35：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：微距，手电光缓慢移动。光圈扫过笔记本：第一页贴着那张蜡笔画，周围爬满了爸爸用铅笔画的网——无数小圆圈，一根根线连着。她的指尖顺着一条线慢慢往外描。环境声：纸页的沙沙声、呼吸声。
情绪：tender, revelatory, quiet
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：macro close-up, slow lateral move following the flashlight beam
景深与虚实：Shallow focus moving with the beam; paper texture crisp in the pool of light.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Flashlight close-up on the open notebook: the child's crayon drawing taped on the first page (the big black box with the red eye and the small smiling boxes holding hands) and the father's dense pencil network diagrams spreading out around it across both pages; a woman's fingertip traces one pencil line. No legible text. Blocking lock: the open notebook fills the frame, the crayon drawing at frame left, pencil diagrams spreading to the right; the fingertip enters from the bottom.
Picture 2: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：paper rustle, soft breathing
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-insert] 机位：细节特写插入
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[rules/light/flashlight-beam] light
[ours/light-flashlight] 现场光：手电与停电
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
